subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should an existing keyed session’s selected model or thinking level be treated as an admin-only mutation when reached through `sessions.create`, while preserving write-scoped fresh keyed creation and idempotent requests?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes a security-sensitive and upgrade-visible operator-scope contract; code review can assess the mechanism, but the repository owner must choose the permanent privilege boundary.

options.title: Confirm the admin boundary and require live proof
options.body: Approve the narrower state-aware admin rule after redacted Gateway runtime output proves write denial, idempotent write success, fresh-key write success, and admin mutation success.

options.title: Preserve current write behavior
options.body: Keep model and thinking selection through keyed `sessions.create` write-scoped if compatibility for existing dashboard or integration clients outweighs the privilege separation.

recommendation.title: Confirm the admin boundary and require live proof
recommendation.body: Approve the narrower state-aware admin rule after redacted Gateway runtime output proves write denial, idempotent write success, fresh-key write success, and admin mutation success.
